recommendedContract.stageIdentity: An operational stage bucket should represent the currently available maximum block for optional exploration, not an assumed invisible game flag. Stable floor-range IDs are independent of date labels.
recommendedContract.entryRule: Even at/after an operational boundary, require exact night entry availability, free slot, party/story restrictions and all existing guards. A boundary never authorizes a trip.
recommendedContract.capAccounting: Count only completed optional expeditions. Exclude mandatory tutorials. Never reset a stage cap solely because a disputed nominal date passed. A verified current block observation can resolve an ambiguous boundary; otherwise retain uncertainty instead of assigning a newly generous bucket.
recommendedContract.historicalMigration: Do not silently reassign existing recorded expeditions or erase counts; ask adapter to reconcile ambiguous date intervals using recorded block and expedition-kind evidence.
recommendedContract.combatAndRescue: Block access proves no floor completion, boss victory, rescue, experience, inventory or yen result.
recommendedContract.recommendationStatus: Prefer operational06-14/07-18/12-10; not a claim of exact underlying flag timings.
